items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: he offered Milt Senior enough money to take our band away from the Chateau de France, and we came to Chicago to play at the new Gold Coast Club

ctx.x: Well, we're jumping the guns here a bit -- I want to get you out of Chicago now. I remember, because I knew you in Chicago.

Oh, back to the story. Toledo. I was with Milt Senior there, when Art left to do the radio job, and a man named Ben Martin came through Chicago and heard us playing at the Chateau de France. Now we had a very soft little band, we didn't have a drummer in the band, and on clarinet, Milt played clarinet always on the low register.
